sources: README.md (Introduction, Installation: 'npm init docusaurus@latest'; the repo is a project for building, deploying and maintaining open source project websites)

https://docusaurus.io/docs/installation project structure rundown (/src/pages files become website pages, /docs ordering via sidebars.js, /blog contains blog Markdown)
